sentences.text: The police have completed the investigation and filed a charge sheet, recording the statements of 11 witnesses, including the statement of the victim under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
5. Since the allegations involve questions of fact to be dealt with by the trial court, this Court finds no grounds to interfere.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to raise all these grounds in the criminal proceedings before the trial court.
6. Accordingly, the criminal petition stands dismissed.
7. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
